title: Pani Na Hua Pyasi Sakina Ko Moyassar
body:
khaime Bhi jale aur Jala Kurta Bahen ka
koi Bhi madadgar Na Tha tashna dahen ka
Bhulunga Nahi sham E ghareeba ka wo manzar
Paani na Hua pyasi Sakina ko Moyassar
<<DIVIDER>>
1
Honthon pe atash Apne sajaye Thi Sakina
Mashkize ko sine se lagayi Thi Sakina
Karti hi rhi sabr har ek gaam pe khaahar
Paani Na Hua Pyasi Sakina ko Moyassar
<<DIVIDER>>
2
Sajjad ne aaghosh mein Lashe ko uthaya
aankhon se Lahu ashq Ki Surat mein bahaya
Rote Hai Sabhi baali Sakina se bichar kar
Paani na Hua pyasi Sakina ko Moyassar
<<DIVIDER>>
3
Zinda'n mein Lahed Bhai Banata Hai Bahen Ki
Gurbat pe Aqi Haye Tadapta Hai Bahen Ki
Qaidi Hai Bahen Aaj Bhi is Qaid mein mar kar
Paani na Hua pyasi Sakina ko Moyassar
<<DIVIDER>>
4
Ye Kaisi Ghadi Haaye Musibat Ki Hai Aayi
Seh Sah Sakta Nhi Bhai Bahen Teri Judai
Tukde Mere hota Hai Jigar dekh ke manzar
Paani na Hua pyasi Sakina ko Moyassar
<<DIVIDER>>
5
Aankhen to Zara Kholo Main Kehta Hai Sakina
Le jaunga main Tujhko watan aai Meri Behna
Q Ruth gyi Mujhse kaho Aai Meri Khahar
Paani na Hua pyasi Sakina ko Moyassar
<<DIVIDER>>
6
Kurte Ko Kafan Aabide Muztar ne Banaya
Nam Khaq ko Karne ke Liye Ashq Bahaya
Sajjad Bht Roye Sakina ko Sulakar
Paani na Hua pyasi Sakina ko Moyassar
<<DIVIDER>>
7
Jab Saans Sakina Ne Liya Aakhri Azhar
Ammar Bahut Tadpa Tha Beemar Baradar
Bhai ko Har ek Lamha Rulata Hai Ye Manzar
Paani na Hua pyasi Sakina ko Moyassar
author: Azhar Gopalpuri
